envelope.description: The aggregator is told which inputs are absent

body.title: The aggregator is told which inputs are absent
body.summary: Add the optional absentInputs to TemplateExecuteArgs and RunAggregatorArgs. runAggregator writes them into the prompt as their own section after the outputs that exist: each name, the task that should have produced it and why it did not, with the instruction that nothing may be stated about an absent input except that it is absent. The five aggregate-report runtimes pass the argument through.
acceptanceChecks: The prompt lists each absent input with its producer and reason after the outputs that exist, and the reference material stays at the end of the prompt
With nothing absent the prompt is the same as today's
Each of the five aggregate-report runtimes passes absentInputs to runAggregator unchanged

tests.name: the aggregator's prompt lists each absent input with its producer and reason after the outputs that exist, and is unchanged when nothing is absent
each of the five aggregate-report runtimes hands absentInputs to the aggregator
